prompt: You post a teasing joke about a friend in the group chat. Others react with laughing emojis, but that friend goes completely silent. What response best repairs it?

options.text: Post another joke to lighten the mood again
Message the friend privately to check if it stung, apologise if it did, and offer to delete it
Wait to see if they bring it up first
Tell the group they are probably just busy and move on

explanation: A private check-in lets the friend be honest without an audience, and offering to delete the post puts their feelings ahead of the laugh.
